definitions.explanation: The act of increasing or improving something, especially health, welfare, understanding, or relations. Implies a positive, deliberate effort to make something better or stronger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧{増進|ぞうしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{努|つと}める→努める：17701_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: To work toward improving one's health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食欲|しょくよく}→食欲：03249_shokuyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{増進|ぞうしん}⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: It has the effect of stimulating appetite.

examples.english: Talks were held with the aim of enhancing friendly relations between the two countries.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly paired with ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧ (health) in the compound ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧{増進|ぞうしん} (health promotion). Also frequently used with abstract concepts like ⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧ (understanding), ⟦{友好|ゆうこう}→友好：03644_yuukou⟧ (friendship), and ⟦{福祉|ふくし}→福祉：13748_fukushi⟧ (welfare). A formal word used in official and written contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧{増進|ぞうしん}: health promotion
- ⟦{食欲|しょくよく}→食欲：03249_shokuyoku⟧{増進|ぞうしん}: appetite stimulation
- {増進|ぞうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧: to seek to promote/enhance
- {増進|ぞうしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{努|つと}める→努める：17701_tsutomeru⟧: to strive to improve
